direction.units: L2-unit nodal direction; coefficient in metres

lowerCertificate.scope: All space×time Bernstein controls for det(current)-binary64(1e-6)*det(reference) strictly positive over every tetrahedron and t∈[0,n/d].

segment.limits: The unsupported upper prefix is a sufficient-certificate limit, not an inversion claim or maximal safe interval. Negative pure corner coefficients at t=1 prove inversion there. Only the saved segment is certified; no material energy/force is evaluated along it.

scalingLimit: Actual saved increments and basis reconstruction checked; raw pre-scaling Newton vector/factor was not archived and is not recomputed.
